text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Urara-san~♪
Are you still fretting over the wedding?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! That's right!
She specially requested me, so I want to make it great, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: How can I make it truly great?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Um, why don't you take a little break with Rice and the others?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
How about an outing?
Maybe an idea will come to you...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOOAL!
Wah~! What an incredible race!
Ikuno-chan, did you see that!? Just now—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness...!
Urara-chan is smiling...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Watching races turned out to be a wonderful refresher.
You truly love racing, don't you?♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The shopping district is fun too.
There are so many neat things here...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Now that you are refreshed, the new stimuli might spark a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Urara-chan!
When is your next race?
We'll bring our banners and come cheer for you again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! I love everyone's cheers!
Before running and while running, it's so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
I believe~
Beyond the dreams~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, everyone harmonized so beautifully together~♪
Perfect synchronization!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Right?! It felt like our hearts became one, and it made me so happy! I got so excited!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun~! Thank you so much for today, everyone!
Today's outing was the best!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we have spent our time most productively.
By the way, did any inspiration strike you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Not a single thing!
It really is tough~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's the matter, Rice-chan?
Are you tired out!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rice is sorry. For not being of any help.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You were trying so hard, Urara-chan, so Rice wanted to support you by inviting you out, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eh? You helped me a whole bunch!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That gloomy "What should I do!?" feeling totally disappeared!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hanging out with everyone made me feel so excited, and I feel like I can give it my all again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Not ideas, but excitement, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Urara-san! Don't you think the alumna big sister asked you with that exact same feeling?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The same... feeling?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text: Watching you try your hardest as a Muse to bring excitement to everyone, Urara-chan—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see... That was it!
I just realized something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I thought I didn't get it at all... but deep down, I knew from the very beginning!
One day, on my way to the trainer's office, I ran into Haru Urara, who was walking along with a bright and cheerful look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yup! Completely! Because I decided to make it an exciting wedding!
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really!? Then let's look up races that'll get the big sister super excited together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And also, and also, I gotta go ask lots of different people! Fufu, there's so much to do~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thank you~! All right, go ahead! Ready, set!
choice_data_list: Fight on, fight on, Haru Urara~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fight on, fight on, U-ra-ra~♪
Ehehe, let's do this!
